sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
For players who are new to puzzle games or are looking to improve their skills, here are some beginner tips and tricks to help you get started:

 Start with the easy levels: If you're new to puzzle games, start with the easy levels and gradually increase the difficulty as you become more comfortable with the gameplay mechanics.

 Focus on one tile at a time: Instead of trying to clear the entire board at once, focus on one tile at a time. This will help you avoid getting overwhelmed and make it easier to solve each level.

 Use your power-ups wisely: Power-ups can be a game-changer in Pixel Cat Mahjong. Use them wisely to clear obstacles, speed up your progress, or increase your score.

 Don't be afraid to ask for help: If you get stuck on a level, don't be afraid to ask for help. You can ask your friends or other players for advice or check out online resources for tips and strategies.

sections.heading: Advanced Strategies
sections.body:
For players who are looking to take their skills to the next level, here are some advanced strategies to help you improve your gameplay:

 Use the right tiles first: When clearing tiles, prioritize the tiles that will clear the most obstacles or create the most opportunities for you.

 Use your power-ups to create opportunities: Instead of using power-ups to clear obstacles, use them to create opportunities for yourself. For example, you can use a power-up to swap two tiles and create a new path for yourself.

 Focus on the board as a whole: Instead of focusing on one tile at a time, focus on the board as a whole. Look for patterns and opportunities to clear multiple tiles at once.

 Don't get attached to your tiles: As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter tiles that are difficult to clear. Don't get attached to these tiles – focus on clearing the tiles that are easy to clear and use your power-ups to clear the difficult ones.
